examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Outlined button trigger. Hover or focus “Hover me” to reveal the tooltip.

examples.name: Placements
examples.summary: All four anchor sides with directional arrow triggers. Hover or focus each icon button to compare placement.

examples.name: AutoPlacement
examples.summary: `placement="auto"` lets the tooltip pick the side with the most available space at open time. The four edge-positioned triggers all share the same prop value — each resolves to the side that fits best, reflected in `data-placement`.

examples.name: LongContent
examples.summary: Long text wraps within the tooltip max width (`var(--container-3xs)`). Hover or focus the info icon to preview the multi-line layout.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Tooltip activation is a no-op; the trigger renders but no hint appears on hover or focus.
